Prerequisites to join the Doctoral School
Please note the following:
An active admission into the Doctoral Programme Computer Science or Business Informatics at the University of Vienna is mandatory for joining the Doctoral School. Get more information on how to apply for the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science from the University of Vienna Admissions Office.
